# Yoley

> Yoley is a free business app for UK tradespeople — sole traders and small trade businesses such as electricians, plumbers, builders, joiners and roofers. It handles quotes, invoices, expenses with receipt scanning, a job diary, customer and subcontractor records (including CIS deductions) and card payments. The app has no subscription; card payments are processed by Monek Merchant Services Limited from 0.99% + 5p per payment on personal cards. Available on iPhone (App Store); Android is in beta. Built and based in the UK by Yoley Limited.

Key facts:
- Price: free, no monthly fee, no tiers, no in-app purchases.
- Card payments (optional): 0.99% + 5p personal cards, 1.99% + 5p business cards, 2.99% + 5p foreign-issued cards; paid out two working days after the payment.
- Records live on the user's phone and their own iCloud or Google backup; Yoley does not hold a database of users' trading.
- Expenses are mapped to HMRC SA103 categories; CIS deductions are calculated per subcontractor. Yoley prepares figures but does not file returns with HMRC.
